lesson_intro.heading: Professional Mode · Lesson 1
lesson_intro.board_text:
AWS Console Orientation
Finova Technologies · finova-dev

Inge paakapooradhu:
• Region selector — resources eppadi 'missing' aagudhu
• Account ID — 12-digit number
• Search bar — fast navigation
• Global vs Regional — IAM vs EC2

Session eppadi work aagum:
• Naan screen share pannitu console-la teach pannuven
• Check questions — mic-la answer pannunga
• Oru practice step ungal turn
lesson_intro.ren_voice: Professional Mode-ku welcome. Naan Ren. IAM policies, launch wizards, tickets — ellam munnaadi, AWS console-la comfortable aaga vendum. Resources enga irukku, missing-nu yennaalum actually illai-ya, experienced engineers eppadi fast-a navigate pannuvaanga — ithu dhaan innaikku focus. Lesson one: Console Orientation. Naan screen share pannitu live-a console walkthrough pannuven, understanding check pannuven. Start pannalaama.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Four things before you touch anything:
1. Account ID (12 digits) — know which account you are in
2. Region selector — controls what you see and where resources are created
3. Search bar — fastest path to any service
4. Global vs Regional — IAM is global, EC2/VPC/S3 are regional
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Console-la yedhaavadhu click panna munnaadi, naaLu vishayam purinjukkanum. Ithai sari-a therinji vachaa, new engineers hours waste panna mistakes ellaathayum avoid panna mudiyum. Miss pannaa, resources disappear aagura-nu oru vaara-nu confuse aagi irupeenga. Oru oru-a, console-layae, ippo kaattuven.

console_segments.console_path: AWS Console Home — Top Navigation Bar
console_segments.board_annotation: Navigation bar: AWS logo | Services | Search | Region Selector | Account Name
console_segments.ren_voice: Top bar parunga. Console-la every single page-layum ithu irukkum — evadha navigate pannaalum, ithu maara maatadhu. Left to right: AWS logo, ithai click pannaa always console home-ku varum. Services menu — click pannaa every AWS service category-a organize aagi kaatum: Compute, Storage, Database, Networking, Security. Center-la search bar — experienced engineers menus click panna povaadha, ippadi-dhan navigate pannuvaanga. Right-la: region selector, evadha data center-la work pannrom-nu kaatum. Adhoda side-la: account name, evadha AWS account-la irukkeenga-nu kaatum. Adha kadeesi vishayam, theriyura maathiri thonum aana romba mukkiyam.

console_segments.board_annotation: Account ID: 12-digit number. Required for support tickets, cross-account access, and IAM trust policies.
console_segments.ren_voice: Account name click pannunga. Adha 12-digit number paakkeengala? Adhu-dhan ungaloda Account ID. Ithu AWS-la ungaloda account-ai uniquely identify pannuchu. Support ticket open panna AWS adhai first-a kekum. Cross-account IAM roles set up panna vendirukkum. Yaaraavathu 'evadha account-la irukkaa?' kekum pothu vendirukkum. Engey irukku-nu therinjukkuvaanga. Moonu seconds.
Region selector enna panna-nu kaatta munnaadi, ungalukku ithai pathi oru instinct irukkaanu check pannanum.
console_segments.question: You create an EC2 instance while the region selector shows ap-south-1 Mumbai. Then you switch the region to us-east-1 Virginia and open the EC2 Instances list. What do you expect to see?
console_segments.ren_response_if_correct: Exactly. Mumbai instance Virginia view-la theriyaadhu. Still running, still billing, aana console Virginia's EC2 list kaatum — adhula onnume illai. Region selector filter illai. Entire context-a maathiruchu. Ithuthan first month engineers-ku most common confusion-oda source.
console_segments.ren_response_if_incorrect: Not quite — region selector deeper level-la enna pannuchu-nu yosinga. Ithu search filter illai. Region select panna ungaloda view pathi exactly enna maaraguthu?

console_segments.scenario: Switching region selector while EC2 instances are running in another region
console_segments.ren_voice: Console-la kaattuven. Mumbai-la moonu EC2 instances running. Region Virginia-ku maatharappo Instances list-a watch pannunga.
console_segments.console_path: EC2 → Instances (ap-south-1 shows 3 instances) → Switch region to us-east-1 → Instances list shows 0 instances
console_segments.lesson: Moonu instances. Running. Account-a billing. Virginia-la irundhu — theriyaadhu. Region selector ungaloda entire view-a control pannuchu. Yedhaavadhu create panna munnaadi, search panna munnaadi, manager-kitta 'missing' sollu munnaadi — check pannunga.

console_segments.console_path: Search bar → type 'IAM' → results dropdown → click IAM service
console_segments.board_annotation: Search bar shortcut: type service name → click result. Faster than Services menu every time.
console_segments.ren_voice: Ippo search bar. AWS years-a use panna engineers almost never Services menu-la click panna poga maataaLa. Ivanga type pannuvaanga. Parunga: search bar click pannuven, IAM type pannuven, udaley dropdown-la IAM top result-a varuchu. Service name-oda keela sub-sections — Users, Roles, Policies — direct links irukkum, adhai straight-a click panna mudiyum. Intermediate page illai. Per navigation seconds save aaguchu, oru naal hundreds of times navigate pannuvom.

console_segments.instruction: Your turn. Use the search bar to navigate to EC2. Once you land on the EC2 dashboard, tell me the current region shown in the region selector.
console_segments.hint_text: Screen-oda top center-la irukkaara search bar click pannunga, EC2 type pannunga.

console_segments.board_annotation: Global services: IAM. Regional services: EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda.
console_segments.ren_voice: Ippo IAM console parunga. Top right-la region selector. 'Global'-nu solluchu. IAM-ku adhai change panna mudiyaadhu. IAM users, roles, groups, policies — account-oda everywhere irukku, region-specific illai. Aana EC2 instances, VPCs, S3 buckets specific regions-la, RDS databases — ellam regional. Resource missing-a therinjaa, first question: ithu service regional-aa? Aamaa-naa, sari-ana region-la paakkiromaa?
Lesson close panna oru kelvi. Ithu ellathayum oru-a bring panna.
console_segments.question: A junior engineer tells you their IAM role is missing — it was there this morning but now they cannot find it. They are currently in ap-south-1. What is the first thing you tell them to check and why?
console_segments.ren_response_if_correct: Right. IAM global — region change-aa role missing aagaadhu. So region problem illai. First check: ivanga irukkura AWS account same-a this morning irundha account-aa? Second: yaaraavathu delete pannaaLaa? Adhai CloudTrail-la investigate pannuvom. Global vs regional therinjukkuradhu alone ivangalukku thirty minutes confusion-a save pannuchu.
console_segments.ren_response_if_incorrect: Close — aana IAM pathi enna sollinomnu specific-a yosinga. IAM global-nu sollinomla. Region selector-ku adhu enna mean pannuchu? Region problem illaa-naa, evadha resources paakkirom-nu veyra enna control pannuchu?

session_close.ren_voice: NaaLu vishayam. Account ID — evadha account-la irukkeenga-nu always therinjukkuvaanga. Region selector — every action, every time, check pannunga. Search bar — navigate panna use pannunga, Services menu click panna poga maateenga. Global versus regional — IAM global, maathavaai ellam regional unless theriyum. Ithu advanced concepts illai. Ithu foundation. Ithai therinja engineers time waste panna maataaLa. Theriyaadhavaaga first month confuse aagi irupaanga.

doubt_session.ren_opening: Console orientation aaguchu. IAM-ku — users, groups, policies, access actually eppadi work pannum-nu — poga munnaadi yedhaavadhu kelvi irukkaanaa?
doubt_session.ren_response_template: Answer the student's question using only the concepts covered in this lesson: Account ID, region selector behavior, search bar navigation, and global versus regional services. If they ask about IAM policy syntax, EC2 launch steps, VPC configuration, or anything service-specific, tell them it will be covered in the relevant lesson.
doubt_session.ren_closing: Nalla. Next: IAM Lesson 1. First IAM user sari-a create pannuveenga — group-oda, scoped policy-oda, day one-layae least privilege. AdministratorAccess illai.
